prompt.text: Name a compound with a benzene ring
prompt.label: Aromatics
prompt.subject: chemistry

answers.name: Buckminsterfullerene
answers.blurb: Sixty carbon atoms in a football of 20 hexagons and 12 pentagons, discovered in 1985. Everyone thinks they're the clever one for saying it, and chemists still argue whether its hexagons count as benzene rings.

answers.name: Benzo(a)pyrene
answers.blurb: Five fused benzene rings, found in soot, cigarette smoke and burnt toast. In 1933 it was isolated from coal tar as a cause of the cancers in chimney sweeps first described in 1775.
